text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, Furio, Espon. Care to join today's 
birthday girl for a movie~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... Won't you go out with me instead of 
giving me a birthday present?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
No way! The stuff you wanna watch is 
always creepy as—wait, no!! It's just 
totally not my vibe, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I have no intention of becoming more 
intimate with central personnel than 
necessary, so—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well, I guess it can't be helped 
then...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! N-No, um. I did intend to celebrate 
in some way, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I just thought, "Watching a movie 
with a friend and shooting the breeze 
about it afterward has gotta be the most 
fun birthday ever!" so...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Gh, ...Aaargh, fine!! Just for today, 
got it?! Bring on the movies or whatever 
else you got, dammit!!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, if it is a request from the 
birthday girl herself, I suppose it cannot 
be helped."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
For real? So stylish~ ...Man, I just love 
that about you two♪
